name: Snacksville
tagline: A hand-picked collection of salty snacks!
description:
There are sweet people, and there are savory people. Some go back and forth, some stay entrenched in their world of sugar or salt. We love both parties, but this gift is for the savory people. If you know someone who likes things that crunch, this is the ticket. Truffle chips, Bazzini Pistachios, Uncle Jerry's Pretzels, Toketti crackers, Taralli, fancy French Cheetos, Flufa...the list goes on! You choose the dollar amount, we handle the snacks. The type & number of items will depend on your budget and we have in stock. One click = a lot of snacks!

*This is a gift, we'll remove the prices!

name: Carnal Beef Sticks, 1oz stick
description: Carnal & Estelle by Carnal are two award winning restaurants in Bellingham, WA, founded by three chef partners who each spent years honing their craft in NY city's Michelin-starred kitchens. These beef sticks are the culmination of those experiences uniting exceptional ingredients like premium beef, fermented black garlic & black truffle with refined techniques. The result? Really good beef sticks people...like, really good.

name: Flufa au Fromage, 125g
description:
What is a flufa? I hate to answer a question with a question, but does it really matter what you call something if it's really, good? Sure there is a technical answer: a fancy cheese twist. If you have not had these, I'll let a good friend of the store describe them...

"These are so good I am confused. How can anything be this good? I'm reading the ingredients and it doesn't make sense. Flour...butter...cheese...I mean, what is going on here?!"

Try for yourself.

name: Flufa Tete de Moine Rosette, 125g
description: If you have had Tête De Moine, you know. Translated, it simply means "Monk's Head." I know, that's not the most appetizing name for anything edible, but when the thing that it is describing is really good, it ceases to matter. Here we have the union between this beautiful cheese, and a crisp, buttery rosette cracker. Similar to it's cheese twist cousin, the rosette gives you another shape to enjoy!

name: Regalis Black Truffle Popcorn, 3x3.5oz bags
description: You love popcorn...you love truffles, so...why not? Made with premium corn and European black truffles, these bags strike a perfect balance between class and convenience, incorporating top-tier ingredients into a long loved snack. Great when watching any type of movie!

name: Uncle Jerry Extra Dark Pretzel, 8oz
description: Uncle Jerry's has been hand-making true sourdough pretzels in Lancaster, Pennsylvania for 20 years. They now have a strong national following, and we're one of the few places to sell these west of the Mississippi River. These gourmet pretzels are slow-baked and blackened. Perfect with a cold beverage of your choice.

name: Uncle Jerry Specials Pretzel, 8oz
description: Uncle Jerry's has been hand-making true sourdough pretzels in Lancaster, Pennsylvania for 20 years. They now have a strong national following, and we're one of the few places to sell these west of the Mississippi River. This is the original, flagship pretzel - perfect with a cold beverage of your choice.

name: Bazzini Pistachios, 1#
description: The Bazzini Company has been roasting and selling high quality nuts since 1886. These small batch roasted, naturally split pistachios are the freshest you'll find. Balanced with just the right amount of salt, all you need is a cold beverage of your choice and your favorite team playing your favorite sport. Seriously, these are the best pistachios ever!

name: Belin Croustilles, 138g
description: Yes, the French eat cheetos too, and with all due respect to USA cheetos, these take the mini mart version out to the snack woodshed. They check the crunchy & cheesey box without checking the preservative & colorings boxes. Belin has been making some of France's favorites snacks since 1902 and these Emmenthaler sticks are a staple. Perfect for aperitif time or riding side car next to the beautifully sandwich you just made. Cheetos with wine or bubbly? Yes, please!

name: Bonilla la Vista Patatas Fritas, 275g
description:
Bonilla a la Vista Patatas Fritas or potato chips are world famous for good reason. Carefully selected potatoes, top quality olive oil and sea salt are the perfect combination. They are a staple at bars around Spain, and have developed a cult following in the process. Have them at the ready to share at your next gathering, or keep them all for yourself!

This tin is packed with a delicious amount of Bonilla a la Vista chips, but also a great collectors item to display at home--repurpose it when you're done, and show off your love for potato chips from Spain!

name: BonBon Gotland Potato Chips Dill & Pickle, 40g
description:
From Gotland's limestone shores, where Baltic tides have shaped the soil for centuries. Each chip carries a little of that northern air — kettle-cooked until seriously crunchy, and flavored with the kind of Scandinavian simplicity that never really goes out of style.

Dill & Pickle: Fresh dill, sharp brine, a quiet nod to the herb gardens of Gotland. Crunchy, tangy, a little bit wild.

name: Brisketchips Thin Crispy Medium Spicy Beef Jerky, 2.5oz
description:
Crafted from richly marbled brisket, this jerky brings the perfect balance of flavor, heat, and chew. It’s the original recipe that launched a Bay Area foodie's obsession and the most addictive jerky we've ever found. Layered with Asian-inspired spices and just the right kick of medium heat, each bite melts in your mouth with a more crunch than the chewing that comes with traditonal jerky.

Handcrafted in small batches, this brisket jerky took home Best Artisan Jerky at the International Jerky Awards four years running! It’s bold, craveable, and dangerously snackable.

name: Dick Taylor 65% Chocolate Coated Almonds, 171g
description:
Adam Dick and Dustin Taylor come from a background of woodworking and boat building. Applying the craft of working with their hands to their chocolate making was a natural progression. They source only the finest fairly traded cacao and perform all the steps of chocolate making in house in Eureka, California. The whole process takes up to three weeks and results in some of the best chocolate that you will ever enjoy.

This delicious treat is made by delicately roasting organic California almonds. Using traditional coating pans, they slowly build layer upon layer of their 65% Tanzania dark chocolate and finish with a dusting of cocoa powder. A modern take on this traditional confection.

name: Koeze Cream-Nut Crunchy Peanut Butter, 16.5oz
description:
The Koeze Company story began 116 years ago when Sibbele Koeze emigrated to America from the Netherlands in the 1880's. He built upon his Old World commitment to handcrafted, artisanal food while establishing in 1910 a thriving produce business in Grand Rapids, Michigan. 3 generations later, the peanut butter is still just as good and we are excited to have it in the store. Thanks to Elyse who can't live without it.

The Crunchy is exactly what you would expect. The same great peanut butter taste, but with extra large, flavorful, Virginia peanut chunks added, to lend an amazing crunchy texture.

name: Koeze Cream-Nut Smooth Peanut Butter, 16.5oz
description:

Cream-Nut is simply the best tasting, all-natural peanut butter available! Koeze has been handcrafting Cream-Nut for over 100 years. Using only fresh Virginia peanuts and sea salt, you can taste the tradition of our remarkable heritage in every jar.

name: Little Latke Potato Crisps, 112g
description:
Little Latke was born from a desire to reimagine the traditional potato latke beyond its seasonal roots. Inspired by years of watching the love for her mother’s famous recipe, founder Taylor Blue had an epiphany: “Why not take the best part of a latke and transform it into a shelf-stable, crunchy snack that can be enjoyed all year round?"

Bringing curiosity, nostalgia, and extra crunch right to your pantry.

Made with natural, simple ingredients, Little Latke is carefully baked with shredded potatoes to achieve the perfect golden-brown crunch.

name: Matiz Organic Chestnuts, 200g
description: Not just for the holidays anymore, these Spanish chestnuts are conveniently peeled, cooked, and ready to use. Sweet and moist, enjoy them straight from the package or use in stuffing, casseroles, salads and desserts.

name: Mitica Marcona Almonds Fried and Salted, 113g
description: Mitica Marcona Almonds are premium, Spanish-grown almonds known as the “Queen of Almonds.” They are plumper, softer, and more buttery than standard almonds. Mitica lightly fries them in sunflower oil and tosses them with sea salt, making them a staple pairng with Spanish tapas, charcuterie, wine, and cheeses. Also a great high protein snack to keep on hand when hunger strikes!

name: Philosykos Sun-Dried Kymi Figs, 230g
description: Grown in the Kymi region of Evia island, Greece, Philosykos figs are hand-picked at the peak of ripeness and sun-dried to perfection, resulting in a sweet, nutritious treat that is packed with flavor and rich in nutrients. In Kymi, they follow the centuries-old tradition of pairing two open figs together, creating the distinctive askada. This artisanal method keeps the figs soft, tender and full of natural sweetness that makes dried Kymi figs world-renowned. These award winning figs deserve space on your cheese board, or really anywhere in reach!

name: Rancho Meladuco Rare and Unusual Dates, 16oz
description: These boutique, handpicked dates grown in the Coachella Valley have been celebrated by Oprah Magazine, Food and Wine, and Sunset. Bon Appetit called them the world’s best dates. This "Heirloom Variety Date Box" features rare, uncommon date varieties like Tarbazal, Dayri, and brown Barhi. These California-grown, seasonally mixed boxes highlight unique, old-world, and new-world varieties designed to showcase diverse flavors beyond the typical Medjool. They make a great snack on their own, a decadent addition to your next charcuterie plate, or add them pitted and sliced to a favorite salad.
